latest.name: ElevenLabs — AI Voice Generator (Eleven v4)
latest.developer: ElevenLabs (Google Play publisher: Eleven Labs Inc.)
latest.category: Voice, speech, music and audio AI
latest.short_verdict: A strong voiceover and text-to-speech workspace with a usable free tier: 10,000 shared credits per month (about 10 minutes of standard TTS). Free output is non-commercial and requires attribution; voice cloning and commercial rights require a paid plan.
latest.what_it_does: Turns scripts into expressive, downloadable speech for narration, social videos, explainers and podcasts. The platform also includes speech-to-text, voice design, sound effects, music and dubbing tools. The featured use case here is voice generation/voiceover, distinct from Suno's AI song-generation focus.
latest.why_try_it: Useful for testing natural-sounding narration without recording a microphone take, producing draft voiceovers for short-form videos, and comparing voices and delivery styles. For best pronunciation, select a voice trained for the language and accent you need; results vary by voice/model pairing.
latest.free_tier: Free plan: $0, 10,000 credits per month and 3 Studio projects. Pricing estimates about 10 minutes of TTS. V2 Multilingual TTS uses 1 credit per text character; exact costs vary by model. Credits are shared across products: official pricing lists about 330 credits/minute for speech-to-text, 900 credits/minute for Eleven Music, 200 credits per sound-effect generation, 1,000 credits/minute for voice changer/isolator, and 2,000+ credits/minute for dubbing. Free includes 3 Voice Design slots; voice cloning is not included. Free credits reset with the billing cycle and do not roll over.
latest.limits: Free-plan output is for non-commercial use with attribution to ElevenLabs. The free plan does not include Instant Voice Cloning (Starter and above) or Professional Voice Cloning (Creator and above), and it has no commercial license. Because credits are shared, using Music, transcription, sound effects or dubbing reduces the same 10,000-credit pool. Credit cost depends on product/model and each generation consumes credits; free credits do not roll over. Voice/accent quality depends heavily on the selected voice and its language training.
latest.signup_pakistan: Pakistan is not named in ElevenLabs' published blocked-country list (which names Belarus, Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Russia, Syria, Crimea, Donetsk and Luhansk). New signups are automatically assigned the Free tier, so a payment method is not needed to try the free plan. ElevenLabs says its mobile apps are available worldwide, but Pakistan-specific signup and Play Store availability were not independently tested. Paid checkout lists credit card, Apple Pay and Google Pay; acceptance of Pakistan-issued cards or local wallet availability was not verified.
latest.quality_evidence: Vendor claim: ElevenLabs describes Eleven v4 as its most expressive speech model; this is a vendor positioning claim. Independent evidence: Artificial Analysis' Provider Voice Arena snapshot checked 2026-11-12 ranks Eleven v4 #1 (Elo 1338±15, 2,722 samples) and Eleven v4 Turbo #2 (1337±16, 2,426 samples). Their confidence intervals overlap, so the one-place gap should not be treated as a meaningful quality lead. Anecdotal adoption: Google Play shows 10M+ downloads; its header and detailed rating panel disagree (4.8/283K versus 4.7/275K), so no single star rating is asserted. Individual recent reviews include praise for voice quality and a report of abuse-detection blocking generation despite available credits; these are anecdotal, not a controlled test.
latest.android_status: Verified official Google Play listing: “ElevenLabs: AI Voice Generator,” publisher Eleven Labs Inc., package io.elevenlabs.coreapp. The listing showed 10M+ downloads and an update on 2026-11-06. Its header showed 4.8 stars/283K reviews while the detailed panel showed 4.7/275K, so the rating is not treated as a reliable single figure. Official documentation says the app is available worldwide; Pakistan-specific storefront availability was not independently tested.
